name: @vektor/proto
description: Source-of-truth contracts for VEKTOR: Zod schemas (TS) + gRPC .proto (TS<->Python boundary). See README.md.

scripts.codegen:py: python3 -m grpc_tools.protoc -I proto --python_out=python/vektor_proto --grpc_python_out=python/vektor_proto proto/*.proto && protol --in-place --python-out python/vektor_proto protoc --protoc-path=python-grpc-tools-protoc --proto-path=proto proto/llm.proto
scripts.codegen: pnpm run codegen:ts && pnpm run codegen:py
